project.name: Nebula — RecruitCRM Java Package Archetype
project.description: Nebula: a Maven archetype that scaffolds a new RecruitCRM Java library/package repository (publishable to AWS CodeArtifact). Modeled after recruitcrm-search-package-java. Pre-configures Spring Boot starter-parent, jOOQ-friendly defaults, Spring Boot AutoConfiguration plumbing, code style (Spotless + Spring Java Format + Checkstyle), Jacoco, semantic-release, Jenkins build pipeline, pre-commit hook and CodeArtifact deployment so a new shared library is publishable after a single command.
